# BodyKit Shop

> BodyKit Shop is a demo car tuning storefront by Dawid Olko: body kits, spoilers, wheels, exhausts and carbon parts, in English and Polish. The catalog is sample data and there is no real checkout.

## Catalog

- [All categories](https://bodykit.dawidolko.pl/en/categories/): the full catalog grouped by part type
- [Packages](https://bodykit.dawidolko.pl/en/packages/): matched sets of parts for a chosen style
- [Front splitters](https://bodykit.dawidolko.pl/en/categories/front-splitters/): front aero parts in ABS, FRP and carbon
- [Spoilers and wings](https://bodykit.dawidolko.pl/en/categories/spoilers/): lips, ducktails and wings

## About

- [About the shop](https://bodykit.dawidolko.pl/en/about/): why the project exists and how fitment is described
- [Help centre](https://bodykit.dawidolko.pl/en/help/): delivery, returns and fitting questions
- [Polish version](https://bodykit.dawidolko.pl/pl/): the same site in Polish

## Author

- [Dawid Olko](https://dawidolko.pl): Fullstack / AI Developer who built this site
